constraints.text: subscribed: second(hello c) = runOf(first(hello c)) (a replaced run holds no subscription)
forall c in subscribed: shown c <= durable(first(hello c))
RequestBeforeHello: no session record, run, subscription or unread count changes
HelloCreate: first hello for a session id creates one record bound to the run
HelloAttach: same session id and run attach to the existing record; no second record
HelloNewRun: record kept, takes the new run; old run's subscription released
HelloNewRun: a new run does not touch another session
RequestReplacedRun: refused with a named error, nothing changes
Subscribe: first frame equals the durable unread summary (invariant 4)
Subscribe requires the connection to be of the current run
Deliver: one arrival is one event, never more than the durable count
Detach: record, run and unread count kept (invariant 3)
Detach: a detached session keeps its presence row and can reattach

uncovered.text: daemonUp = zfalse => opened = {} (a restart returns every record to dormant)
uncovered.suggestion: Kill and restart the daemon; assert every record exists and none has a connection
uncovered.testPattern: assert all(r.connections == 0 for r in daemon.records)

uncovered.text: known subseteq sessions (a record exists only for a session that exists)
uncovered.suggestion: Assert the daemon holds no record for a session the structural layer lacks

uncovered.text: DaemonExit: known', runOf' and durable' unchanged
uncovered.suggestion: Restart; assert records, runs and unread counts unchanged

uncovered.text: DaemonStart: restart then reattach, unread equals durable (none lost, none counted twice, invariant 4)
uncovered.suggestion: Send mail while the daemon is down; reattach and assert the first summary equals the durable count

uncovered.text: Arrive is enabled whether or not the daemon is running
uncovered.suggestion: Write mail with no daemon running; assert it is delivered after restart

uncovered.text: ReadUnread: every subscribed connection of that session sees the empty summary
uncovered.suggestion: Subscribe two connections of one session; read on one; assert both see zero

uncovered.text: SessionEnd: only the SessionEnd hook of the current run removes the record; unread stays
uncovered.suggestion: Send SessionEnd from the current run; assert the record and its connections are gone and unread mail remains
uncovered.testPattern: assert session not in daemon.records and unread == before

uncovered.text: SessionEnd precondition: a connection of the current run exists
uncovered.suggestion: SessionEnd from a replaced run is refused
uncovered.testPattern: assert session in daemon.records after stale-run end

uncovered.text: RetentionExpire: only a record with no connection expires
uncovered.suggestion: Age a dormant record past retention and a live one; assert only the dormant one is removed
uncovered.testPattern: assert dormant not in records and live in records
